name: Oguruma Kodai
source:
The kindhearted and lively head detective. He used to be a cop, but he chose to resign and open up his own detective agency. You have known him since you were a child, and he is the person you trust the most. He is always cheerful, showing a tactless side at times, but he also has a surprisingly sensitive side to him too...

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.tanteikaigai]Google Play[/url]]
